services.description: Sihlanganisa hlelo lwekuqukethwe, kuklama lubuke, nekwenta ngetekhinikhali kuze iwebhusayithi yakho ingabi ku-inthanethi kuphela, kodvwa isebente ngempela.
services.0.title: Iphothifoliyo yemuntfu / i-CV
services.0.description: Iwebhusayithi yeliphothifoliyo noma i-CV yemuntfu yekwetfula umlandzo wakho, lwati, nemsebenti wakho ngendlela lenelisako.
services.1.title: Likhasi lekwetfula noma umlandzo wenkampani
services.1.description: Likhasi lekwetfula noma umlandzo wenkampani lolulungiswa masinyane, lolubukeka lucinile, futsi lulungele kuheha bakhasimende.
services.2.title: Luhlelo lwemininingwane nemisebenti
services.2.description: Emadeshibhodi, emaphothali, nemasistimu ekhaya ekuphatsa imininingwane yakho nemisebenti yelilanga nelilanga yebhizinisi.
services.3.title: Kwenta imisebenti ngekwayo
services.3.description: Yenta imisebenti lephindvaphindvwako njengekwatisa, kuhlanganisa emathuluzi, nenchubo yekusebenta kuze sive sakho songe sikhatsi.
process.description: Sigaba ngasinye sinemiphumela longayibona, uyihlole, uphindze uyivume. Wati kahle kutsi umsebenti uhamba kuphi.
process.0.title: Kuhlola tidzingo
process.0.description: Siveza tinhloso tebhizinisi, tibonelo tekubukeka, tici letibalulekile, netintfo lekufanele kwentiwe kucala.
process.1.title: Kubuyeketa lubuke
process.1.description: Likwakhiwo, lubuke, nendlela yekuhamba kuyabuyekeswa futsi kuvunyelwane ndzawonye ngembi kwekwakha.
process.2.title: Kwakha
process.2.description: Iwebhusayithi, i-app, noma lokwenta ngekwako kwakhiwa kulingane nesikrini kuya ngelubuke lolutsatsiwe.
process.3.title: Kubuyeketa umphumela
process.3.description: Umphumela uyabuyeketwa ndzawonye, ulungiswe uma kudzingeka, futsi uhlolwe kuze ulungele kuvulwa.
process.4.title: Kuvula nekudlulisa
process.4.description: Umkhicito uyabekwa ku-inthanethi, i-metadata ne-SEO ilungiswe, bese kunikwa wena ekufinyeleleni nemlandzelo.
services.0.long: Iwebhusayithi yeliphothifoliyo noma i-CV yemuntfu likhaya lakho lelisemtsetfweni ku-inthanethi. Umlandzo wakho, lwati, nemsebenti wakho kuhlangene kahle ekhasini linye lelelula kwabelana ngalo nebasebenti, bakhasimende, noma tikolishi.
services.0.for: Labasanda kuphothula, labasebenta bodvwa, bakhi bekuqukethwe, nebasebenti labafuna kubukeka bacinile.
services.1.long: Likhasi lekwetfula noma umlandzo wenkampani siyasita ibhizinisi kutsi lenze umbono lomuhle wekucala. Sakha indlela yekhasi, emagama, nekubukeka kuze baivakashi baphute baqonde lokuniketako futsi bativa bakhutsatiwe kuxhumana nawe.
services.1.detail.3: Kulungisa i-SEO kuze utfolakale kalula ku-Google
services.1.detail.4: Kuyashesha kuvulwa nje kwamatfupha ematsetfulo akho
services.1.for: Emabhizinisi, tikolo, emakhefi, emimango, nemacembu lafuna kubukeka ngekwemsebenti.
services.2.long: Luhlelo lwemininingwane lulungisa umsebenti lokhona lowakhanyiswe etipredishithi, emanothi, nasekuchatheni. Imininingwane isendzaweni yinye, ingafinyelelwa ngelitfuba, futsi imibiko ingabukwa nanoma nini.
services.2.detail.0: Indlela yekusebenta lehlelekile lelandzela indlela usebenta ngayo
services.2.for: Tikolo, tikhungo, emashabhu, emapulazi, nemacembu lafuna kuphatsa imininingwane ngendlela lehlelekile kakhulu.
services.3.long: Imisebenti lephindvaphindvwako njengekutfumela tatiso, kuhambisa imininingwane emkhatsini we-app, noma kwenta imibiko yelilanga nelilanga ingahamba ngekwayo. Licembu lakho lisindzisa sikhatsi futsi liyagcina emaphutsa ekubhala.
services.3.for: Emabhizinisi nemasive lanemisebenti leminyenti leyentiwa ngesandla futsi iphindvaphindvwa.
process.0.long: Ngembi kwekwakha loko, sifuna kuqonda ibhizinisi lakho: yini inhloso, baivakashi bobani, nekutsi tiphi tici letibalulekile kakhulu. Kusuka lapho sibeka tintfo letibalulekile kucala kuze umsebenti uhlale unamandla futsi uvikele kuchitseka kwemali.
process.0.do.2: Kukhetsa tici letilulu kakhulu nekulandzelana kwemisebenti
process.0.you: Sitjele tidzingo takho futsi wabelane ngetibonelo temawebhusayithi lowatsandzako.
process.0.result: Luhlu lwetidzingo netintfo letibalulekile lolwavunyelwana ndzawonye.
process.1.long: Sibeka likwakhiwo lekhasi nesithombe selubuke kucala. Ungabuyeketa futsi unikete imibono ngembi kwekwakha, kuze umphumela wekugcina ube seduze nalokuyicabangile.
process.1.you: Buyeketa lubuke, bese unikeza imibono noma kuvuma.
process.1.result: Lubuke lolwavunyelwana ndzawonye ngembi kwekutsi kucale kwakhiwa.
process.2.long: Uma lubuke selivunyiwe, iwebhusayithi, i-app, noma lokwenta ngekwako kuyakhiwa. Kulingana nesikrini efonini nasekhompyutheni, futsi ungabelana ngemibono ngesikhatsi umsebenti uchubeka.
process.2.do.1: Kuqinisekisa kutsi kubukeka kahle efonini, ethebulethini, nasekhompyutheni
process.2.do.2: Kulungisa tisekelo kuze utfolakale kalula ku-Google
process.2.you: Lungisa emagama, tithombe, nemalogo, ubelane ngemibono uma unayo.
process.2.result: Inguqulo yekucala longa yilingisa. Iwebhusayithi lelula ngalokuvamile iphela emalangeni la-1–3 ekusebenta uma tintfo selilungile.
process.3.long: Silinga umphumela ndzawonye. Konkhe lokungakalungi kuyalungiswa, bese konkhe kuphindze kuhlolwe kuze kusebente kahle ezintfweni letehlukene futsi kulungele kuvulwa.
process.3.you: Linga umphumela futsi usitjele lokufuna kulungiswe.
process.4.long: Umkhicito uyabekwa ku-inthanethi futsi uvulekele wonkhe umuntfu. Siwulungisa kuze utfolakale kalula ku-Google, bese sikunika ekufinyeleleni nemlandzelo wekusebentisa kuze uwuphatse ngekukhululeka.
process.4.do.3: Kukusekela ngenyaka loku-1 wekunakekelwa kwamahhala, kanye nedomeyini (iphakheji Lencane) noma i-hostingi (iphakheji Lenkhulu)
process.4.you: Gcina ekufinyeleleni kwakho kuphephile futsi uphe kwabelana nebakhasimende bakho.
process.4.result: Iwebhusayithi noma i-app iku-inthanethi futsi ilungele kusetjentiswa.
projects.description: Umsebenti ngamunye uklanyelwe kutsi uchazele ngalokucacile umlayeto webhizinisi, uhlale ulingana nesikrini kuyo yonkhe imitsetfo, futsi wente kube melula kubasebentisi kutsi bangenise sento.

packages.0.description: Iwebhusayithi yeliphothifoliyo, i-CV yemuntfu, noma likhasi lekwetfula lelelula lelivulwa masinyane.
packages.1.description: Umlandzo wenkampani, luhlelo lwemininingwane nemisebenti, noma kwenta ngekwako lokuklanyelwe tidzingo takho.
faq.title: Imibuto lemvamisa ivela ngembi kwekucala.
faq.description: Uma umbuto wakho ungakaphendvulwa lapha, umhlangano weseluleko ungasita kunquma tidzingo takho.
faq.0.question: Yini Nocoding lengayakha?
faq.0.answer: Sakha imawebhusayithi yeliphothifoliyo noma i-CV yemuntfu, emakhasi ekwetfula noma imilandzo yenkampani, imasistimu yemininingwane nemisebenti, nekwenta tinchubo tebhizinisi ngekwato.
faq.1.question: Inchubo yekwakha ithatsa sikhatsi lesingakanani?
faq.1.answer: Iphothifoliyo yemuntfu, i-CV, noma likhasi lekwetfula lelelula ngalokuvamile lithatsa emalanga la-1-3 ekusebenta ngemuva kwekutsi tintfo tilungile. Imisebenti lemikhulu kuya ngetidzingo tetici, kuhlanganiswa, nesivinini semibono.
faq.2.question: Ngabe lubuke netici kungalungiswa?
faq.2.answer: Yebo. Lubuke, likwakhiwo lekhasi, tici, nendlela yekusebenta kungalungiswa kuya ngetidzingo takho. Lubuke luyabuyeketwa ndzawonye ngembi kwekutsi kucale kwakhiwa.
faq.3.question: Yini lefakwe ekutsengeni?
faq.3.answer: Intsengo ifaka kwakha kuya ngephakheji nesikhatsi lesivunyelwene ngaso. Iphakheji Lencane ifaka kunakekelwa kwamahhala nedomeyini ngenyaka loku-1, kantsi iphakheji Lenkhulu ifaka kunakekelwa kwamahhala ne-hostingi ngenyaka loku-1.
contact.title: Sitjele tidzingo takho tewebhusayithi. Sitakusita kulungisa indlela.
contact.description: Tfumela sifinyezo lesifushane sebhizinisi lakho, emakhasi lofuna wona, nesikhatsi lofuna ngaso. Impendvulo yekucala itawufaka seluleko ngesikhatsi nekulandzela. Iseluleko sihlala singemahhala, nanoma nini lodzinga ngako.
footer.tagline: Imawebhusayithi webhizinisi lalungele kuvulwa, labukeka lucinile, futsi lelula kukhula.
project.description.ecoswap: Imakethe ku-inthanethi yekutsenga nekutsengisa tintfo letisetjentisiwe. Bantfu bangafaka, babuke, batsenge kalula bacala efonini noma ekhompyutheni.
project.description.wiboost: Isitolo ku-inthanethi setinsita tedijithali njengekufaka imali emageyimini, emaphakheji edatha, nema-app lakhokhelwako, nemali yebakhasimende neluhlelo lwebatsengisi.
project.description.ahawi: Iwebhusayithi yeliphothifoliyo yemuntfu ngesitayela sekudvweba ngemidvwebo yemanti ngetilwimi letimbili, yekwetfula umlandzo, lwati, nemininingwane yekuxhumana.
project.description.abdi: Luhlelo lwemarekhodi yebasebenti bepalesi (abdi dalem) beKeraton yaseSurakarta: kubhaliswa, imininingwane yemuntfu, emashejuli emisebenti, kuvela, nekushicilela emakhadi eligamu.
project.description.sfarm: I-app yekuphatsa umphandze wetinkhukhu tetigodzi netimbuti wesigodzi: emarekhodi emalanga onkhe, kutsengisa, tindleko, nemibiko yetimali.
project.description.payu: Sikhulumi lesixhumanisa labafaka imisebenti nebasebenti labazimele. Labafaka imisebenti banikela ngemvuzo, basebenti bayayiphetsa, bese kukhokhwa nge-QRIS.
project.description.darcasual: Ikhathalogi ku-inthanethi lenemikhicito lengetulu kwenkhulungwane. Batsengi bangatfola, bahlunge, bese batjela ngqo nge-WhatsApp.
project.description.ianprem: Isitolo ku-inthanethi sema-akhawunti ema-app lakhokhelwako njenge-Netflix ne-Spotify. Batsengi bakhetsa bakhokhe bodvwa, kantsi baphatsi baphatsa sitoko nekutsengisa.
project.description.alengka: Ikhathalogi ku-inthanethi yefenisha yangaphakatsi nangaphandle yemakhefi, emarestorenti, nemakhaya. Baivakashi bangabuka lokukhona, babuze nge-WhatsApp.
project.description.sdn: Iwebhusayithi lesemtsetfweni yesikolo sasekuqaleni lenemlandzo wesikolo, imininingwane yekwemukelwa kwebafundzi labasha, luhlu lwebothishela, imisebenti yangaphandle, nemphumelelo yebafundzi.
project.description.furnix: Ikhathalogi ku-inthanethi yefenisha yensimbi evela eJepara yemakhefi, emarestorenti, nemakhaya. Baivakashi bangakhetsa imikhicito babese batjela ngekuthanda kwabo.
project.description.clothique: Isitolo setembatfo lesiphelele ku-inthanethi: ikhathalogi, ingobolo yekutsenga, kukhokha ku-inthanethi, ibhulogi, nendzawo yemphatsi yekuphatsa tioda nemibiko.
project.description.agli: Lithuluzi lemacembu ekuqukethwe ekuhlanganisa tibonelo tekuqukethwe lokubukwe kakhulu, abone tindlela, abhale tihloko letisha.
project.description.nebulist: Umsiti wekutsengisa lososekelwe ku-AI lokwenta luhlelo, emanothi ebatsengi labangaba khona, nemadrafti ematfuba ekuxhumana kusuka kumininingwane yemkhicito.
project.description.carbonfi: I-app yetimali tedijithali yekutsengisa emakhredithi ekhabhoni (imivuzo yekunciphisa emisi) neluhlelo lwemivuzo lephephile kwemvelo.
project.description.protectedpay: I-app yekutfumela imali yedijithali ngekuphepha: imali ikhishwa kuphela uma selamukelwe, nekukhokha kwemacembu nekonga.
project.description.pedulichain: Sikhulumi sekunikela lesicacile: sipho ngasinye nendlela imali lesetjentiswe ngayo kuyabhalwa ngalokuphelele futsi kubonakala kunoma ubani.
project.description.astra: Umsiti we-AI longakhuluma naye kuphela kuze uphatse umcebo wedijithali, njengekutfumela emathokheni noma kwakha tintfo tedijithali letigcinwako, ngaphandle kwekwati kukhowuda.
project.description.auditfi: Umhloli wekuvikela losekelwe ku-AI weluhlelo lwetimali tedijithali lokutfola tindzawo letibuthakathaka futsi ubhale umbiko ngemizuzwana.
project.description.p2p: Sikhulumi sekushintjisana kwemcebo wedijithali ngqo emkhatsini webasebentisi, sinekuvikelwa kwemalungiselelo nendzawo yemphatsi yekuphatsa sikhulumi.
project.description.payguppy: I-app lesita emashabhu lavamile kwemukela kukhokha ngemali yedijithali ngemakhodi e-QR labenawo kakade.
project.description.tiptap: Sikhulumi sebakhi bekuqukethwe sekwemukela tipho kubabukeli ngemali yedijithali noma tintfo letigcinwako tedijithali, ngetatiso ngesikhatsi sekusakata bukhoma.
project.description.senkus: Igeyimu ku-inthanethi yesayensi ne-alkhemi: abadlali bahlanganisa emaphoshini, babuthe tintfo tedijithali, bese bendlelana enkundleni.
project.description.quickstock: I-app yekhompyutha yekuphatsa sitoko sesitolo setembatfo: kubhala kutsengisa, kuletfwa kwebatsengisi, nemibiko yesitoko, ngekufinyelela kuya ngebhaso lemsebenti ngamunye.
project.description.caer: Sikhulumi sekuboleka nekuboleka imicebo yedijithali emkhatsini wemanethiwekhi sinekusekela kwemali yedijithali ye-IDRX yerupiya, kwenta kube melula kukonga nekuboleka.
